title: Fine saturated nodal pushout monoid and its monoid-algebra model
statement: Let $P$ be a fine saturated commutative monoid, with group completion and fineness/saturation as in [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], written additively, and let $a\in P$. Put $R=\mathbf Z\oplus P$. Let $Q=\mathbf N^2\amalg_{\mathbf N}R$ be the pushout of commutative monoids for the maps $1\mapsto(1,1)$ and $1\mapsto(1,a)$; explicitly $Q$ is the quotient of $\mathbf N^2\oplus R$ by the congruence generated by $((1,1),0)\sim(0,(1,a))$. Then $Q$ is fine saturated, and the canonical map $g:R\to Q$ induces an injection $g^{\rm gp}:R^{\rm gp}\to Q^{\rm gp}$ with cokernel isomorphic to $\mathbf Z$. For every commutative ring $A$, multiplicative monoid map $\alpha:P\to(A,\cdot)$ and unit $\varepsilon\in A^\times$, give $A$ its $\mathbf Z[R]$-algebra structure by $(n,p)\mapsto\varepsilon^n\alpha(p)$. There is a canonical isomorphism of $A$-algebras $A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]\cong A[u,v]/(uv-\varepsilon\alpha(a))$, taking the two generators from $\mathbf N^2$ to $u,v$ and the elements of $R$ to the specified units and base monomials. Here $\mathbf Z[S]$ denotes the commutative monoid ring: the free abelian group on symbols $[s]$ with multiplication $[s][t]=[s+t]$.

source.place: Expose VI, Proposition 1.9 proof, printed p. 71: cocartesian monoid square defining Q, cartesian monoid-ring square, and injectivity/cokernel calculation for g.
